name: Intense Dandruff Kit
subtitle: For Dandruff & Scalp itchiness
description: While the shampoo only addresses your surface level issue , dandruff is more than that. It is rooted in variety of factors like excess oil production due to physical activities, inflammations etc. That's where the complete dandruff rescue kit comes in. It helps with: 1️⃣Deeper penetration into the scalp 2️⃣Ongoing treatment 3️⃣Proven dual action formula The kit is backed with powerful ingredients: 1️⃣ Zinc Pyrithione addresses surface fungal and bacterial infections 2️⃣ Menthol provides itch relief and cooling senasation 3️⃣ 1% Ketoconazole Strong anti-fungal properties helps fight dandruff prevents excess sebum production 📆Use the serum twice a week Shampoo 2-3 times a week consistently for 3 months
usage: How to use (1% Ketoconazole Dandruff Shampoo) Step 1 : Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Step 2 : Take ~teaspoon of shampoo in your palm and apply directly to your scalp and hair strands. Step 3 : Leave in for 1-2 minutes and rinse well. How to use( Anti Dandruff Serum) Step 1 : Apply Anti- Dandruff Serum on the scalp and gently massage. Step 2 : Leave it on overnight or for a duration of at least 6 hours Step 3 : Shampoo your hair with 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo and follow up with a conditioner.

list.title: How to use (1% Ketoconazole Dandruff Shampoo)
list.content:
Bodywise’s Anti Dandruff Pack is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.
Step 1
Wet your hair with lukewarm water.
Step 2
Take ~teaspoon of shampoo in your palm and apply directly to your scalp and hair strands.
Step 3
Leave in for 1-2 minutes and rinse well.

list.title: How to use Anti Dandruff Serum
list.content:
Anti Dandruff Serum is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.
Step 1
Apply approximately 1 tea spoon of Anti-Dandruff Serum on the scalp and gently massage.
Step 2
Leave it on overnight or for a duration of at least 6 hours
Step 3
Shampoo your hair with 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo and follow up with a conditioner.

list.title: How long must I use this 1% Ketoconazole Dandruff Shampoo to see results?
list.content: You will notice visible reduction in dadnruff after 2-3 washes. Use this 1% Ketoconazole Dandruff Shampoo for at least 12 weeks to stop dandruff completely. This shampoo has ketoconazole to help you stop the growth of dandruff immediately.

list.title: What else can I use with this 1% Ketoconazole Dandruff Shampoo for women? Will it make my hair too dry?
list.content: Ketoconazole has slight drying properties. You can use Bodywise's Moisturising Conditioner for women to moisturise & nourish your hair along with Bodywise's Hair Strengthening Serum to strengthen your hair follicles & protect your hair.

list.title: Can I use it during the day?
list.content: Yes, you can apply during the day. Make sure you apply it for at least 6 hours.

list.title: Will this make my hair dry?
list.content: No, this effective formulation of tea tree oil, menthol in combination with zinc pyrithione & ICHTHYOL® PALE does not not dry your hair.

list.title: Will this lotion give instant relief?
list.content: Yes, it gives an instant and long lasting cooling effect to relieve you from itching and inflammation. You can notice reduction in dandruff from the first wash and significant results in 2-3 washes

list.title: Is this lotion safe to apply at night? Will it irritate my skin?
list.content: This lotion is completely safe to use and doesn't cause any side effects.

list.title: Does this lotion come with an applicator?
list.content: The bottle comes with an inbuilt applicator which makes it easy to use and apply.

list.title: Is this lotion to be applied on hair strands or just on the scalp?
list.content: Since this is a treatment lotion, it's recommended to part your hair and apply it directly on your scalp.

list.title: What are the side effects?
list.content: There are no side effects. However, if you face excessive dryness or irritation in your scalp due to the ketoconazole in the shampoo, consult an expert.
